e-reply-by-email.1.evidence: Settings > Reply by Email has no Enable box (2.0.7); with IMAP method and no host the page says "Not set up yet. Fill in IMAP Host, IMAP Username, IMAP Password, or choose the webhook method. Until then no reply address is added to emails." Saved domain mail.example.test + Inbound webhook -> "Reply by Email settings saved."; the page shows the inbound URL and the read-only signing secret (no secret field to type). The IMAP "Leave blank to keep" placeholder was empty because no password is stored. A bad domain "not a domain!!" -> "Email Domain was not changed: it must be a domain such as reply.example.com. The previous value was kept. Your other changes were saved." and the stored domain stayed localhost

e-reply-by-email.2.evidence: Reply by Email is on its default unconfigured IMAP method here (reply notifications to admin and bob carry no Reply-To), so inbound token handling was not set up; not reached in this browser pass
